newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Mubarak meets Iranian FM Velayati.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak meets Iranian FM Velayati.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on Tuesday met Iran's Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati, the first high-level Iranian visit to Cairo since 1994, government officials said.
Velayati told reporters on Monday he would give Mubarak an invitation by Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani to an Islamic summit in Tehran in December.
Foreign Minister Amr Moussa, who attended the meeting, met Velayati at the foreign ministry on Monday.
Egypt has accused Iran and Sudan of supporting the al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), the largest organisation fighting for a strict Islamic state in Egypt. Both Sudan and Iran deny this.
Iran was also accused of being behind the attempted assassination of Mubarak during the Egyptian leader's visit to Ethiopia in 1995.
Velayati last visited Cairo in 1994 to attend a Non-Aligned Movement meeting of foreign ministers.
The Iranian minister told reporters that problems facing the Middle East would benefit from better ties between his country and Egypt.
"We do believe that cooperation between Iran and Egypt would be very constructive," Velayati said after more than two hours of talks with Moussa.
